_evidence: Re-pins the ring_00405a12 walk geometry for the 0x0042c1f4 composition (compose AFTER rel_0042c0c4, links_0042b3c8 and links_00405a12). Two later layouts broke ring_00405a12's proof that the 0x405c9a/0x405d05 walks stay inside records 0..14 (both ORIGINAL timeouts, 2/400, ran in those walks): (1) rel_0042c0c4 redraws [0x866f04] over records 0..30, but 0x406051 (forward step onto the pit end [0x866ef8]) jumps to [0x866f04], so a pit exit placed inside the pit or past the varied records made the forward walk from 0x406123 (via 0x42b6c2, edi = car +0x1c) cycle forever; ring_00405a12 places it at records 0..1 (0x42c0c4's 0x4062b1 only subtracts/compares it, so any record value is valid there). (2) links_00405a12, composed after links_0042b3c8, links records to 0..11, while 0x42b3c8 starts its backward walk at link + first*0x160 with first (+0x7c) 0..2, i.e. up to record 13 (case 110 started at record 12 and timed out); links_0042b3c8 bounds the targets to records 0..9 (start <= 11). Dword +0x44 is therefore: records 0..8 zero (0x4059d2 stc / 0x42b3c8 clc exits, lap records only) or a link to records 0..9; records 9..25 always a link to 0..9, because 0x4059d2 loads [edi+0x44] unconditionally at or after the pit start [0x891500] (records 9..10) and a zero link there faults (links_00405a12).
